findings: `learner.overview.text` calls the branch word’s sound match merely possible, but omits the essential reason it cannot be verified: the pictured tool’s ancient name and pronunciation are unknown. State that the graph was proposed for reuse because the words may have sounded alike, while making clear the tool’s old pronunciation is not known (for example, “午 is interpreted as a pestle picture. One proposal says it was reused for the seventh earthly-branch word because the words may have sounded alike, but the pestle’s ancient name and pronunciation are unknown.”).
